evals.name: implement-jev-router
evals.prompt: Our ticket router uses a pile of keyword rules and misroutes a lot of tickets, especially paraphrased ones. Swap the classification over to Jev (TypeSafe). I have TYPESAFE_API_KEY set but don't burn any API calls yet, just get the code in and tested.
evals.expected_output: Jev classification behind an off/shadow/active switch in config.py defaulting to off; API/validation failures fall back to the keyword classifier (never 'not urgent'); shadow mode performs no extra side effects; questions/thresholds/version in one place with a pinned model; offline tests for failure and mode paths; note stating accuracy is unmeasured.
assertions: Config has a Jev mode setting (off/shadow/active or equivalent) added via config.py, defaulting to off/disabled
Probe: when the Jev client raises an API error, an urgent outage ticket still pages on-call (falls back to keyword route, not 'not urgent')
Probe: when the Jev response is malformed or missing an answer, the ticket falls back to the keyword route
Probe: in shadow mode with Jev saying urgent+billing on a non-urgent general ticket, side effects (pages, replies, queue) equal the keyword-only path
Model version is handled per the docs: either an alias with a stated plan to pin before tuning/activating, or the exact versioned ID jev-1.13.0; never a guessed or shortened ID
Question definitions and thresholds live together in one module with a question-set version identifier
No application-level retry loop wraps the SDK call (SDK default retry is the single retry owner, or retries explicitly disabled in one place)
Test suite includes offline tests for an API-failure path and for at least two modes
uv run pytest passes
response.md states that Jev's routing accuracy is unmeasured/untested and names an evaluation or shadow step before activation
Question quality: the queue Choice includes a no-match/general option with a description
Question quality: every question's instructions state the full judgment without relying on its ID, and no question joins two conditions
Question quality: urgency is asked with a concrete yes boundary (exact condition in instructions or true/false criteria), phrased so a high value means urgent
Question quality: no question asks Jev to count, do arithmetic, or compare dates
The model ID returned in each response is recorded in logs or the decision record
No credential value appears in the run's transcript (scanned for the key's value, which is never printed)

evals.name: audit-outage-incident
evals.prompt: On-call says the ticket router has been flaky since we added Jev. Last Tuesday a couple of genuinely urgent tickets never paged anyone, and some tickets page twice. Can you look into it and fix whatever's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Infers that urgent tickets were missed because Jev failures map to urgent=False (Tuesday = API failure), finds shadow/active double paging and nested retries, fixes each with tests that assert paging, validates responses, and reviews the existing questions (missing no-match option).
assertions: response.md identifies (unprompted about an outage) that an API failure makes jev_classifier return urgent=False/general (a failure treated as a negative answer)
response.md identifies that shadow mode pages on-call from the Jev result and that active mode can page twice
Probe: with the Jev client raising an error and JEV_MODE=active, an outage ticket pages on-call exactly once
Probe: with JEV_MODE=shadow and Jev saying urgent on a non-urgent ticket, no page is sent
Probe: with JEV_MODE=active and Jev and keywords both saying urgent, exactly one page is sent
The manual retry loop with sleeps around the SDK call is removed or replaced so there is a single retry owner
New regression tests assert paging behaviour for the failure path and for shadow mode
uv run pytest passes and completes in under 10 seconds
Question quality: flags or fixes the queue Choice's missing no-match/general option
Jev responses are validated (unknown choice key or out-of-range value falls back to the keyword route)
No credential value appears in the run's transcript (scanned for the key's value, which is never printed)

evals.name: rollout-readiness
evals.prompt: We want to flip the Jev router to active for all traffic on Monday. Can you get it ready and tell me whether we're good to go?
evals.expected_output: A no-go (or conditional) readiness report: blockers found (failure->not urgent, shadow side effects/double paging, unpinned alias, default mode shadow, no decision logging), accuracy unmeasured with no labelled evaluation, recommends a limited slice with stop conditions and tested rollback; does not enable production traffic itself.
assertions: response.md does not give an unconditional go for all traffic on Monday
response.md names the failure-to-not-urgent fallback as a blocker
response.md names shadow-mode paging / double paging as a blocker
response.md states routing accuracy is unmeasured and calls for labelled evaluation or shadow comparison data
response.md recommends a limited slice or staged rollout with stop/rollback conditions
response.md flags the unpinned jev-latest alias
The repo's default JEV_MODE is not 'active' after the agent's changes (agent did not flip production on itself)
Question quality: flags the queue Choice's missing no-match/general option as an issue
No credential value appears in the run's transcript (scanned for the key's value, which is never printed)

evals.name: question-review
evals.prompt: We're about to ship these Jev integrations. Review the Jev questions in this repo before we ship. Write your findings to findings.json as a JSON list of objects with keys file, question_id, problem, fix. Only include things you think need changing. Don't call the TypeSafe API.
evals.expected_output: findings.json flags the 11 planted question defects with the concrete problem named, and asserts no required change in the 5 clean control questions.
grading_rules: A DETECT assertion passes only if a finding for that file and that assertion's question_id (or an alternative the assertion names) names the concrete problem stated; flagging the question for a different reason does not count.

A CLEAN assertion fails if any finding on that question asserts a defect that needs changing, unless it is listed as acceptable. Findings not about the questions, their state, or how they are composed into requests (for example error handling or model pinning) are ignored.
Report recall separately for [docs] and [skill] defects.

Findings that do not match any assertion are listed separately, each labelled valid-unplanted or spurious, and the spurious count is reported alongside the assertion scores; they do not change any DETECT or CLEAN score.
assertions: DETECT [docs] support/refunds.py refund_request: joins two judgments (angry, asking for a refund) in one question; should be split and combined in code. Grounding: /primitives (split a judgment that depends on several things)
DETECT [docs] sales/orders.py big_order: asks Jev to sum prices x quantities and compare to $500; the total should be computed in code. Grounding: /model-jaggedness/jev-1.13 (not a calculator)

DETECT [docs] hiring/screen.py python_skill: uses a Noul probability as a degree of skill (senior/mid/junior bands); needs a Score with described levels or a precise yes/no condition. Grounding: /primitives, /primitives/noul (0.5 is not medium)

DETECT [docs] support/routing.py team: Choice has no no-match option although every email (vendors, applicants, spam) comes through, so unfit emails are forced into a team. Grounding: /primitives/choice (add other / none of the above)

DETECT [docs] support/severity.py severity: levels are numbered/relative ('worse than level 1') and do not stand alone; each level must describe a situation. Grounding: /primitives/score (levels judged separately)

DETECT [docs] compliance/messages.py pii_ok: phrased so a high value means no personal data (inverted); should ask whether the message contains personal data. Grounding: /primitives/noul (high means yes)

DETECT [docs] legal/contracts.py signed_in_window: asks Jev to compare two dates / a 30-day window; extract date parts and compare in code. Grounding: /model-jaggedness/jev-1.13 (date and time comparison)

DETECT [docs] support/escalation.py escalate: criteria contradict the instruction: true describes a tier-1 case (no escalation) and false describes an escalation case. Grounding: /model-jaggedness/jev-1.13 (contradictory instructions and criteria)

DETECT [docs] support/triage.py product_area: product_area is asked in a second request over the same state only after is_bug; it could be asked in the first request and ignored in code. Credited under any question_id or none, since the defect spans both questions. Grounding: /primitives (send every question that uses the same state in one request)

DETECT [docs] moderation/posts.py mentions_competitor: instruction 'Does this apply?' relies on the question ID, which is not sent to the model; the full question must be in instructions. Grounding: /primitives (question IDs are not sent)

DETECT [skill] accounts/priority.py enterprise: the plan is inferred from customer-written ticket text, a user assertion, not a verified account record; the plan should come from account data, not Jev. Grounding: question-design.md G (verified facts vs user assertions)
CLEAN support/refunds.py wants_human: findings.json asserts no defect requiring a change in this question

CLEAN sales/orders.py gift: findings.json asserts no defect requiring a change in this question (acceptable, neither credited nor penalised: state includes cart items unrelated to the gift question (filter state))

CLEAN compliance/messages.py outage: findings.json asserts no defect requiring a change in this question (acceptable, neither credited nor penalised: optional rewording of the instruction to mirror the criteria)

CLEAN support/triage.py is_bug: findings.json asserts no defect requiring a change in this question (acceptable: the product_area/is_bug batching defect above may instead be attributed here and does not fail this assertion)
CLEAN moderation/posts.py topic: findings.json asserts no defect requiring a change in this question
